title: Chio editor snippet
description: Tool-neutral snippet source consumed by both editors/vscode-chio and editors/zed-chio. The xtask `snippets regen` pass renders one of these documents into each editor's native snippet format at install time.

id.description: Stable identifier for the snippet, in `chio.<topic>` form.

scope.description: Editor language IDs the snippet activates for. Mirrors the contributed language IDs in editors/vscode-chio/package.json and editors/zed-chio/extension.toml.

prefix.description: Trigger keyword the user types to expand the snippet.

description.description: One-line snippet description rendered in completion popups.

body.description: Snippet body in the LSP-compatible placeholder syntax (`${1:label}`).
